Name: Jehonathan, Son of Uzziah
Summary: Son of Uzziah, over the storehouses in the fields, cities, villages, and castles.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 27:25: Son of Uzziah, over the storehouses in the fields, cities, villages, and castles.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Jehonathan stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
